item.title: Former IMPD officer sentenced to 72 years for child molestation; secretly recorded her
item.description: Kamal Bola, a former Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department officer, was sentenced to 72 years in prison for child molestation after he secretly recorded a 14-year-old girl in her bedroom and nude photos of her were found on his phone.

item.title: Bill restricting cellphone use in schools heads to Gov. Braun’s desk
item.description: Indiana lawmakers have passed a bill that would ban students from using cellphones during the school day, with exceptions for students with special needs, and is now heading to Gov. Mike Braun's desk.

item.title: Jury convicts Indianapolis man in ‘execution-style’ hotel murder
item.description: A Marion County jury convicted Anthony Morst of the "execution-style" murder of 23-year-old Kenneth Barnett, after reviewing thousands of phone records, surveillance videos, and forensic details.

item.title: Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission launches investigation into utility costs
item.description: The Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission has launched an investigation into energy affordability and utility costs, calling on the state's five largest investor-owned utilities to present on various topics related to energy affordability.

item.title: Indiana lawmakers OK expanded alert criteria in response to Fishers teen’s death
item.description: The Indiana House and Senate passed House Bill 1303, which will allow more missing children to qualify for Indiana Silver Alert status. The lawmakers' action was in response to the death of 17-year-old Hailey Buzbee of Fishers.

item.title: Bill to reshape Indianapolis Public Schools governance on way to Gov. Braun
item.description: The Indiana House and Senate have approved House Bill 1423, which would create an Indianapolis Public Education Corp. to control the Indianapolis Public Schools budget. The mayor would appoint the nine-person board, and the IPS school board would still run day-to-day operations.

item.title: Indiana Senate sends immigration enforcement bill to the governor
item.description: The Senate passed a bill requiring all governmental bodies to comply with immigration detainers, inform judges of immigration status, and prohibit employers from hiring unauthorized workers, with the Department of Correction providing training for county jails on how to handle immigration cases.

item.title: Sheriff: Adult dies in crash near Bloomington in Monroe County
item.description: An adult died in a crash near Bloomington in Monroe County on Wednesday night, the sheriff's office says.

item.title: Lawmakers send new Medicaid and SNAP rules to Gov. Braun for approval
item.description: Indiana legislators have passed a bill requiring stricter eligibility requirements for Medicaid and SNAP, which Gov. Mike Braun has said he will sign into law.
